title: Tame trait charts with a specified divisor equation
statement: Let S be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, c:C\to S a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth map with geometrically connected fibres, and sigma:S\to C a section. Let G be finite with invertible order, and Z a finite etale G-torsor on the generic fibre C_eta. Let U contain eta and PA be a finite etale model of Z over C_U, with compatible generic-fibre pullback squares, and let seta be the generic section compatible with sigma [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let s outside U be minimal under specialization among points outside U, with A=O_(S,s) a DVR. Put a:Spec A\to S, L=C times_S Spec A, and n:N\to L the concrete pullback of the relative normalization of PA\to C; assume n finite. Write tau for the induced section of L. For every x of N above tau(m_A), there are R, an etale map phi:Spec R\to L, a point y over n(x), a ring map rho:A\to R, and a uniformizer varpi of A with m_A=(varpi), such that phi composed with L\to Spec A is Spec rho and rho(varpi) belongs to y. There are m and positive integers e_k indexed by Fin m and an isomorphism over Spec R from N times_L Spec R to Spec of the product of R[T]/(T^(e_k)-rho(varpi)).

proof.text: Compare the concrete stalk normalization n with the normalization of a Galois cover W of the local generic fibre, over the smooth trait total space. The comparison preserves its projection. Choose an irreducible uniformizer of the DVR and map invertibility of the group order to its stalk ring.

Construct an affine open neighborhood of n(x) and take its actual structural ring homomorphism from the trait ring, as in the smooth trait affine generic-open construction. Retain the equality of its Spec map with the structural morphism. Localizing a DVR at an irreducible uniformizer is its fraction field, so the generic fibre of this chart is the basic open of its image. Smooth regularity ascent gives regularity of the chart and its quotient by the uniformizer; flatness gives injectivity of multiplication by the equation. The section identity implies that n(x) projects to the closed point, so this equation lies in the chart prime.

Apply the prescribed-equation punctured Kummer chart theorem at that prime. Compose the etale neighborhood with the affine chart, and compose its ring map with the trait structural ring map to obtain rho. Contravariance of Spec proves the structural equality. The prime-comap equality transports uniformizer membership to the new prime.

Form the full product root algebra using f=rho(varpi). Its stalks are integrally closed domains by normality of regular-divisor root models. Each factor is free over the base by monicity, so multiplication by f remains injective on the product. Localization is therefore injective, and the basic open D(f) is dense by the spectrum criterion for density of comap. The finite monic algebras are finite over the Noetherian etale chart, so the full model is locally Noetherian.

The punctured-cover isomorphism and the normal dense-open normalization theorem identify the relative normalization with the full root model. Construct the two inverse comparison maps by normalizationDesc and prove they are inverse by its universal property. Etale normalization base change identifies this with the normalization pullback. Finally pull back the original stalk-normalization comparison and compose the isomorphisms; their projection equalities give exactly the displayed structural equality. The uniformizer maximal-ideal identity and positivity of the exponents complete the existential witnesses.

theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_trait_divisor_charts {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    let τ : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ pullback c a :=
      pullback.lift (a ≫ σ) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ])
    IsFinite n → ∀ x : (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
      (pullback.fst c a) : Scheme.{u}),
      n x = τ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (S.presheaf.stalk s)) →
      ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ pullback c a) (y : Spec R)
        (ρ : S.presheaf.stalk s →+* R) (ϖ : S.presheaf.stalk s),
        Etale φ ∧ φ y = n x ∧
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (S.presheaf.stalk s) = Ideal.span {ϖ} ∧
        φ ≫ pullback.snd c a = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ρ) ∧
        ρ ϖ ∈ y.asIdeal ∧
        ∃ (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ k, 0 < e k) ∧
          ∃ α : pullback n φ ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
              AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ρ ϖ)))),
            α.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (algebraMap R (∀ k : Fin m,
                AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ρ ϖ))))) =
              pullback.snd n φ
